name: channel_reply_draft_user
content: Draft a short reply to the latest message below. Respond with ONLY the JSON object.
## Thread context (locally distilled — for grounding only, do not quote verbatim)

variables.name: subject
variables.description: Thread subject (metadata; may be redacted for sensitive threads).

variables.name: sender
variables.description: Sender of the message being replied to, as 'Name <address>' or a channel handle.

variables.name: latest_message
variables.description: The message being replied to. Exists in process memory only and is discarded after the local draft.
examples: Are you free for lunch Friday around noon?

variables.name: thread_summary
variables.description: The locally-derived distilled thread context (never a raw body dump) used to ground the reply.
examples: Alex and the owner have been trying to find a time to meet this week.

variables.name: hint
variables.description: Optional owner redraft instruction (for example 'make it warmer' or 'decline politely'). Empty when the owner has not asked for a specific change.
examples: keep it casual and say yes

metadata.description: User prompt paired with channel_reply_draft_system v1.0.0. Injects {subject}, {sender}, {latest_message}, {thread_summary}, and optional {hint}; the model returns a short first-person reply draft as strict JSON {"draft": string}.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial channel-assist reply-draft user prompt.
